svg.title: Chat schema
svg.desc: Channels and their members, messages (threads by value) with reactions, saved messages and pins as cascading satellites, polls, attachments, scheduled messages, thread links and link previews, plus the live co-editing drafts for docs pages and whiteboards, personal status, the member roster and workspace settings in the chat schema of the workspace database.
svg.text: CO-EDITING DRAFTS · DOCS PAGES AND WHITEBOARDS
NOT DRAWN outbox, processed_events, dead_events (standard shapes) · known_members.user_id ↔ channel_members.user_id (logical, used to fill default channels)
